description: Games ranked by a simple, transparent LFG Atlas score: open LFG Atlas posts (people looking for a group now), official updates in the last N days and the game's own live player count from its official source. Each game has why, latest_update (official link), players (source, scope total or steam_only, as_of) and board_url. Player counts are the game's players, never LFG Atlas traffic; always say the source and scope.
name: whats_hot
title: What's hot right now
